title: Autodesk Assistant on 20 Community-Tested Tasks: What Failed?
summary: Review 20 sourced Autodesk Assistant task results, including YouTube timestamps, partial outputs, successes, and ArchiLabs Desktop as an alternative.
body_markdown:
Autodesk Assistant has produced real wins in community tests—and some results that needed correction or did not materialize. The useful question for a BIM team is which part of the workflow succeeded: the response, the tool call, or the actual model deliverable.


We collected **20 task-level checks** from published firsthand reports, including a timestamped YouTube review. These are separate reviewers’ results on different models and releases, not an ArchiLabs benchmark or a single controlled 20-task experiment. Some rows are follow-up operations within the same workflow. We do not calculate a universal success rate from them.


The sources were checked November 10, 2026. Autodesk can update Assistant independently of Revit releases, so a dated failure is evidence about that test, not proof that every current installation will behave identically.[Autodesk’s capability documentation](https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2027/ENU/Revit-Assistant/files/GUID-620ECD98-53F7-47F1-B700-EEE84F15EBF7.html) provides the current product context.


## Autodesk Assistant community tests: 20 tasks and their reported outcomes


### Interscale: sheets, walls, and schedules


[Interscale’s October 2 review](https://interscale.com.au/blog/what-can-autodesk-assistant-do/) reports David Gerber’s Revit 2027 tests, begun during Tech Preview with key prompts retested afterward.


1. **Renumber sheets:** Completed the requested A100 sequence.
2. **Uppercase sheet names:** Partial; one sheet was missed.
3. **Place a view:** Placed centrally on the sheet.
4. **Match a view position:** Two further placements matched the reference corner.
5. **Find 300 mm walls:** Returned IDs that selected the correct walls.
6. **Change wall type:** Needed the exact existing type; four changed, one already matched.
7. **Create a door schedule:** Produced an initial schedule.
8. **Add a field to an existing schedule:** Failed with that wording.
9. **Refine schedule fields/grouping/sorting:** Follow-ups left extra schedules.
10. **Place grids:** Supplied instructions without placing grids.
11. **Recreate the schedule with an added field:** The rephrased request worked.


The unchanged fifth wall in task 6 was already the target type; it is not a failed edit.


### BIMsmith: documentation and room workflows


[BIMsmith’s April 7, 2026 firsthand report](https://blog.bimsmith.com/Revit-2027-How-Autodesk-Assistant-Bridges-the-Gap-Between-Intent-and-Execution) covers the early Revit 2027 Assistant experience.


12. **Export a view to PDF:** Reported success, with the output path returned.
13. **Color rooms by name:** Produced visual color coding, but could not create the native Color Fill Legend object.
14. **Translate room names and recolor:** Updated the 16 tested rooms and applied the new visual scheme.
15. **Assemble sheets and place views:** Completed the sequence; final viewport fit still needed review.
16. **Summarize door types and counts:** Returned the inventory with distribution by level.
17. **Turn the door inventory into a schedule:** Created a live door schedule on follow-up.


These results show why a useful-looking view and the exact requested native artifact should be evaluated separately. The original article includes screenshots of its outputs.


### Bridge To BIM: Revit 2027.3 and Dynamo 4.2.1


Bridge To BIM’s[“Can You Trust Autodesk Assistant With Dynamo? I Tested It”](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q7rAZVHV-qU) identifies the recording environment as Revit 2027.3 with Dynamo 4.2.1. The outcomes below come from the creator’s published description and chapter markers; we are not presenting them as our own rerun.


18. **Create levels from Excel:** The creator reports successful level creation.[Watch from 2:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q7rAZVHV-qU&t=134s) .
19. **Build a tower:** The test reported success without a visible tower.[Watch from 4:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q7rAZVHV-qU&t=263s) .
20. **Export door data to Excel:** The creator found problems when checking the spreadsheet.[Watch the export from 7:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q7rAZVHV-qU&t=479s) and[the inspection from 10:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q7rAZVHV-qU&t=631s) .


The video also covers a cube, graph explanation, and warning resolution. We have not assigned those segments pass/fail outcomes from their titles alone.


## What failed—and what the failures mean for a project team


The practical lesson is to define completion in terms of the deliverable. A chat response can be polished while the requested change is incomplete. A generated graph can exist without producing the expected model. An export can be written successfully while containing unsuitable data.


Use an acceptance check that a colleague could repeat. For a batch operation, compare the expected target set with the resulting set. For documentation, inspect the native object and the actual sheet. For a workbook, open it and check the relevant identifiers, values, and units against the model. For geometry, inspect the resulting elements in an appropriate view rather than relying on a completion message.


This is an evaluation framework, not a demand that every assistant be perfect on the first request. A useful assistant should help resolve ambiguity, carry the assignment forward, and make the outcome easy to inspect. Measure the complete workflow, including follow-up instructions and any cleanup required before another person can use the result.


## The promise of Autodesk Assistant in Revit 2027


The promising shift is conversational access to real model and documentation work. Autodesk’s current documentation describes supported queries, modifications, attachments, and export workflows. Its[Dynamo support article](https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Create-Dynamo-graphs-with-Autodesk-Assistant-in-Revit-2027-3.html) explains that graph creation and editing arrived with Revit 2027.3 and Dynamo 4.2.x; graphs must run to affect the model, and external package installation remains separate.


That version distinction matters. An early launch review cannot settle the capabilities of a later graph-enabled release. Equally, a new capability announcement does not establish reliability on your office’s templates, families, packages, or workshared projects. Read the current release information, then choose an assignment with an output your team can inspect.

## A better way to evaluate AI Revit automation software


Give each candidate the same project brief, source files, target elements, and definition of completion. Keep the software versions and follow-up prompts with the result. Review the native deliverable and the time spent reaching an acceptable outcome.


A compelling trial is a real office assignment: turn an equipment reference into a family, reconcile a register with selected model elements, or prepare a defined documentation package. That reveals how the assistant understands context, responds to corrections, and leaves work that another team member can continue.[See what ArchiLabs Desktop offers](https://archilabs.ai/desktop) and bring the task your team wants to stop doing manually.
